sources.title: d1-3B - llmmodels.org
sources.snippet: d1-3B is a newly released open decision model from Liquid AI's d1 family. Released in October 2026, it is designed for efficient decision-making rather than conventional token-by-token text generation. The model supports text and image inputs and is optimized for low-latency inference on edge hardware.

sources.title: Liquid AI Opens d1-3B and d1-omni-600M Decision Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI's new d1-3B scores 48.57 on the Decision Index v0.2.1, a benchmark the company controls, which it says puts the model "ahead of every model under 10B and on par with Decider 35B-A3B, a decision model 12x its size." Its smaller sibling d1-omni-600M scores 15.95 on the same split. The models do not generate text.

sources.title: Open d1: Edge decision models for text, vision, and audio
sources.snippet: Today, we release d1-3B and d1-omni-600M, two open-weight models in our d1 decision model family. d1-3B scores 48.57 on the Decision Index v0.2.1 (public split), ahead of every model under 10B and on par with Decider 35B-A3B, a decision model 12x its size. It runs the full NVIDIA stack, from DGX in the data center to Jetson at the edge: d1-3B answers a question in 8 ms on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX ...

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal ...
sources.snippet: Liquid AI has released Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models in its d1 decision model family. d1-3B reads text and images. d1-omni-600M reads text with an image, or text with audio. Neither model writes text. Each returns calibrated, typed answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens.
